headline: 暑期尾声无新片，热门大片持续霸榜
headlineEn: No New Releases Today, Blockbusters Keep Trending
summary: 今日无新片上映，本周共有4部新片。而《怒之杀》《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》《玩具总动员5》等影片持续霸榜，备受关注。接下来《最后的日出》即将上映。
summaryEn: No movies released today, with 4 new movies opening this week. Titles like Fury Kill, Spider-Man: Brand New Day, and Toy Story 5 continue to dominate the trending charts, while the upcoming The Last Sunrise is already generating excitement.

industryHighlights.text: 今日无新片上映，影市略显平静。
industryHighlights.en: No new films were released today, leaving the box office relatively quiet.

industryHighlights.text: 本周共有4部新片入市，为市场注入新鲜血液。
industryHighlights.en: Four new films hit theaters this week, injecting fresh energy into the market.

industryHighlights.text: 《怒之杀》蝉联今日热度榜首，讨论度居高不下。
industryHighlights.en: Fury Kill tops today's trending chart with sustained buzz.

industryHighlights.text: 《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》与《玩具总动员5》持续占据本周趋势榜。
industryHighlights.en: Spider-Man: Brand New Day and Toy Story 5 remain strong on this week's trending list.

industryHighlights.text: 备受期待的《最后的日出》即将上映，引发影迷关注。
industryHighlights.en: The highly anticipated The Last Sunrise is coming soon, drawing fans' attention.
